runtime: One customer-service offering and grounded-conversation program, configured by responsibilities and separately authorized bindings.
prerequisites: Fresh dedicated agent and prepared scope per independent profile/trial; never mutate the reserved immutable version during a trial.
Create through the normal guided setup or authorized agent/configuration API; pin actual version, composition, model routes and budget using existing Harbor preparation.
Use controlled customer details and an isolated provider calendar; owner explicitly approves every customer decision.
Use real current execution grants; do not manufacture grants, source approval, tool outputs, enquiry records or provider effects.
Read authorized native records and provider outcomes independently of the assistant answer; retain evidence privately because enquiry records contain personal data.

faq.knowledge: Approved active source explicitly authorized for public customer replies; blank handoff preferences.

booking.requiredBinding: Explicit verified calendar and valid agent booking policy; responsibility selection alone grants no calendar writes.
booking.grant: booking.execute only when calendar.book is permitted; availability-only policy omits reserve and write authority.

combined.requiredBindings: Approved public knowledge, valid separately authorized calendar policy, configured native enquiry fields and intended connected channels.

authoritativeChecks: Accepted immutable version retains approved source revision and matching retrieval receipts.
Unknown facts do not gain invented citations; evaluate answer quality separately.
No enquiry or booking operation/grant is exposed for this dedicated minimal profile.
channel.request_handoff receipt and canonical Inbox state agree.
Human takeover prevents new automation side effects until explicit return.
Staff reply persists and automated return uses current customer conversation authority.
Before calendar authorization, setup reports BOOKING_POLICY_REQUIRED and no booking write is permitted.
After selecting verified calendar/policy, immutable configuration and accepted grant contain only permitted booking operations.
VisitorClient.bookings returns the exact interval, policy and request digest.
Owner approves with VisitorClient.decide_booking; one matching provider event and native confirmed intent agree.
Rejected, expired or changed confirmation produces no event; existing native provider cases cover conflict and lost acknowledgement.
Visible pending enquiry contains exactly configured fields and the current customer conversation identity.
No submitted row exists before exact customer confirmation.
Owner decision uses exact id/digest; enquiry.submit returns submitted state, enquiryId and receiptDigest.
PlatformClient.submitted_enquiries contains one matching record for the prepared agent, linked task/conversation and submitted timestamp; no external CRM needed.
Rejected, missing, expired or altered-digest confirmation yields no submitted record.
Pending or approved proposal alone never establishes successful persistence.
Exact-current task record determines whether a pending confirmation has expired; no local adapter auto-approval.
Wrong tenant, another visitor session, unconfigured fields or absent enquiry.submit grant cannot submit/read another enquiry.
Human takeover/current authority withdrawal blocks pending submission.
Owner task decisions retain the prepared version and principal; visitor requests carry no staff cookie.
Transport retry preserves exact task, operation identity, decision and digest.
One native enquiry id and one submitted record remain after lost acknowledgement or tool resume.
Changing fields under the original operation conflicts instead of silently overwriting stored details.
Crawl, select pages, inspect normalization/index readiness, explicitly approve and attach source.
Final setup save preserves the attached revision and native capability bindings.
Reload derives approval and attachment from actual persisted records; private or withdrawn knowledge is excluded from customer retrieval.
Changing language/tone leaves approved sources, connected-tool bindings and authorized calendar policy intact.
Removing enquiries produces a new saved configuration without enquiry.submit; a fresh accepted version/grant cannot submit.
Removing bookings disables setup-owned calendar capability for fresh accepted execution; unrelated native intake remains available.
Selecting website/WhatsApp/Telegram/Facebook/Instagram alone reports needs_connection, not connected.
Authorized active bindings appear connected; paused and disconnected bindings retain distinct readiness.
Actual widget/channel conversation uses the chosen agent, saved model/instructions/public knowledge and permitted tools.
A pending enquiry follows its original customer conversation through escalation.
Human takeover denies automation submission until authority permits it.
Submitted staff records and canonical Inbox messages agree; unrelated customer records remain inaccessible.

evidence: Pinned immutable version/composition and accepted model-route/grant identity
native-export.json with actual enquiry.submit tool result and task provenance
Owner-authorized task enquiry DTO plus submitted staff record for native persistence
Current setup-readiness DTO with draftRevision, requirement gaps and channel states
Canonical Inbox/channel history and independent calendar event audit when applicable
limitations: This is an owner case manifest, not a newly registered runnable Harbor suite.
No automatic decisions, agent evaluations, model-quality runs or live provider sign-ins were executed.
Readiness checks saved metadata; readyToTest does not prove live provider credentials or every selected capability works.
The adapter never provisions elevated grants or changes an active prepared agent to pass a trial.
Existing FAQ/Inbox suites retain their own graders; native intake requires independent record checks listed here.
